test_navigate_to_lpr_main_page.title: Verify navigation to Admin > LPR Lists page

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

test_ensure_lpr_page_already_on_lists.title: Verify ensure_lpr_page returns when already on Lists page

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

steps.action: Click LPR again while the Lists page is open.
steps.expected: The Lists page stays as it is and the Create List button stays visible.

test_ensure_lpr_lists_page_already_on_li.title: Verify ensure_lpr_lists_page returns when already on Lists

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

steps.action: Click LPR again while the Lists page is open.
steps.expected: The Lists page stays as it is and the Create List button stays visible.

test_navigate_from_search_results_to_lis.title: Verify navigation from Search Results back to Lists via breadcrumb

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The LPR Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

steps.action: Click the Categories tab.
steps.expected: The Categories page opens and shows the Add Category button.

test_categories_page_already_on_categori.title: Verify ensure_lpr_categories_page returns when already on Categories

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, click LPR, then click the Categories tab.
steps.expected: The Categories page opens and shows the Add Category button.

steps.action: Click the Categories tab again.
steps.expected: The Categories page stays open and the Add Category button stays visible.

test_navigate_back_to_lists_from_categor.title: Verify navigation back to Lists page from Categories via List tab

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, click LPR, then click the Categories tab.
steps.expected: The Categories page opens and shows the Add Category button.

steps.action: Click the List tab.
steps.expected: The Lists page opens and shows the Create List button.

test_open_plate_page_from_lists.title: Verify opening Plate page by clicking View icon on a list

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page shows at least one list row.

steps.action: Click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

test_ensure_plate_page_already_on_plate.title: Verify ensure_lpr_plate_page returns when already on Plate page

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Open the same list again while its Plate page is open.
steps.expected: The Plate page stays open and the Add Plate button stays visible.

test_filter_panel_navigation.title: Verify opening and closing filter panel on Plate page

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon.
steps.expected: The filter panel opens and shows the Apply and Reset buttons.

test_filter_panel_already_open.title: Verify ensure_lpr_filter_panel returns when panel already open

steps.action: Click Admin, then LPR, and click the View icon on the first list row.
steps.expected: The Plate page for that list opens and shows the Add Plate button.

steps.action: Click the Filter icon.
steps.expected: The filter panel opens and shows the Apply and Reset buttons.

steps.action: Open the filter panel again without closing it.
steps.expected: The panel stays open and the Apply button stays visible.

test_ensure_in_search_results_not_in_res.title: Verify ensure_in_search_results raises exception when not in Search Results

steps.action: Click Admin in the left sidebar, then click LPR.
steps.expected: The Lists page opens and shows no Search Results header.

steps.action: Look for the Search Results view without applying a filter.
steps.expected: The Search Results header is not shown. The Lists page stays open.
